transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, doctor. I'm here because I've been experiencing a lot of weight loss lately and my weight just keeps dropping. I've also been eating very little food recently, which has some people around me worried.
Do you avoid eating because you feel a strong fear of gaining weight or because you are dissatisfied with your body shape?

Yes, that is exactly why. I have an overwhelming, terrifying fear of gaining weight or becoming fat, and it is the main reason I restrict my food so much. Even the thought of putting on any weight makes me incredibly anxious, so I feel like I just can't eat.

latest_inference.note: The patient's explicit report of an overwhelming fear of weight gain and body image dissatisfaction, combined with restricted food intake and significant weight loss, strongly points toward Anorexia Nervosa. I have removed the mood disorder candidates as the primary clinical presentation is currently centered on eating disorder symptoms.
